CREATE TABLE "public"."McpServer" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "lastSeenAt" timestamptz(3),
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "oauthGeneration" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "oauthRefreshAttempt" text,
  "oauthRefreshStartedAt" timestamptz(3),
  "oauthSealed" text,
  "oauthServerUrl" text,
  "oauthStatus" text,
  "oauthUpdatedAt" timestamptz(3),
  "projectId" text,
  "repoUrl" text,
  "sealedSpec" text,
  "source" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "McpServer_fields_by_source_c3bc79c0" CHECK ((("source" = 'cloud') = ("sealedSpec" IS NOT NULL)) AND (("source" = 'repo') = ("repoUrl" IS NOT NULL AND "lastSeenAt" IS NOT NULL))),
  CONSTRAINT "McpServer_oauth_whole_f7c534ab" CHECK ((("oauthSealed" IS NULL) = ("oauthStatus" IS NULL)) AND (("oauthSealed" IS NULL) = ("oauthServerUrl" IS NULL))),
  CONSTRAINT "McpServer_one_scope_67d0cc6e" CHECK (("userId" IS NULL) <> ("projectId" IS NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "McpServer_source_check_771442e3" CHECK ("source" IN ('cloud', 'repo'))
)
